svg.title: Interactive potential field and magic hexagon
svg.desc: Edit the potential field on the left. Each step adds or subtracts an alternating six-cell lattice on the magic hexagon on the right. Duplicate values and out-of-range values are highlighted in red.

g.text: All lines guaranteed to sum to 0
